candidats.titre: File:US Navy 050215-N-2385R-042 Steel Worker 3rd Class Mat Martin, assigned to Naval Mobile Construction Battalion Four Zero (NMCB-40), Detachment Sasebo, operates a mechanized hand tamper to compact the gravel over a foundation.jpg
candidats.description: Sasebo, Japan (Feb. 15, 2005) - Steel Worker 3rd Class Mat Martin, assigned to Naval Mobile Construction Battalion Four Zero (NMCB-40), Detachment Sasebo, operates a mechanized hand tamper to compact the gravel over a foundation before concrete is poured. The Seabees of NMCB-40 are constructing a pre-engineered building for a fire station in Sakibe Training Area. NMCB-40 is on a regularly scheduled deployment from their homeport in Port Hueneme, Calif. They are scheduled to conduct various upgrades to existing facilities and facility installation projects on board U.S. Fleet Activities, Sasebo

candidats.description: The bottom of a mat foundation of a tipped building (right side of photograph). This type of foundation is made by pouring concrete over a mat of pebbles. The soil has failed due to liquefaction. Sakarya is to the east of Izmit, north of Arifiye, and west of Duzce. The provincial capital of Sakarya is Adapazari.
